title: Peter’s Greatest Failure Wasn’t His Final Identity
headline: How Jesus Restores a Man After Failure
headline_sub: Peter’s Failure Wasn’t His Final Identity
tagline: God remembers your calling longer than your failure.
seo_title: How Jesus Restores Men After Failure: Peter in John 21 | TheWrkShop
seo_description: Peter denied Jesus around a charcoal fire, and Jesus restored him around another one. A devotional for men on John 21:15-17 and Psalm 103.
verse_text: Simon, son of John, do you love Me?…. Feed My sheep.

scriptures.text: Simon, son of John, do you love Me?…. Feed My sheep.
As far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions from us.

items: Jesus revisited the place of Peter’s deepest shame.
It returns to painful places so healing can finally happen.
Condemnation keeps replaying your worst moments.
Jesus revisits them only to rewrite their ending.
Peter’s denial did not become his identity.
His identity was restored before his mission was renewed.
God remembers your calling longer than your failure.
He often transforms it into the very place where grace becomes unforgettable.
